outcomes.lapped: Classified, one or more laps down.
outcomes.retired: Started but did not finish (DNF). May still be classified.
outcomes.dns: Entered and qualified but did not start.
outcomes.dnq: Did not qualify or pre-qualify (never started).

causes.accident: Driver crash or spin with no other car involved.
causes.contact: Collision with another car, or damage from one.
causes.operational: Team or pit-stop error: fuel, wheel nut, refuelling.

notes.grid: null when Jolpica reports 0. pitLaneStart is true for such rows from 2000; before that it is null because the grid slot was usually just not recorded.
notes.finish: null unless the row is classified; retired drivers keep their outcome and cause instead of a position.
notes.teammates: Other drivers entered by the same constructor in the same race, with their finish, outcome and grid.
notes.sharedDrive: True when another entry holds the same finishing position (1950s shared cars).
notes.points: As awarded at the time. Use scoring/rescored for other points systems.
